title: Kenyan Spicy Shrimp Tacos
description: A fusion of Kenyan and Mexican flavors in this spicy shrimp taco recipe. The combination of tender shrimp and crunchy slaw makes for a delicious and unique meal.
instructions: Heat the spicy stir-fry sauce in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the chopped red onion and cook for 2-3 minutes, until softened.
Add the shredded cabbage to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the chilled coconut milk and cook for 1 minute, until heated through.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few shrimp on each tortilla, then topping with the slaw mixture and cilantro.
Serve immediately, with lime wedges on the side.
